answer: A falcon scouts a mesa before any claim is staked. Each newcomer must be scouted by two witnesses whose own records predate it, and each witness may scout one newcomer per epoch, so n aliases need n separate scouts that cannot be reused. Every scouting report is sealed at the forge, where the k-th seal an operator files costs k squared in bond, making a farm pay near n cubed while still requiring fresh outsiders. A report contradicted on replay voids every claim it supported, and sealed reports cannot be sold, lent or re-dated.
